prompt:
Hi, I run VetPaw Clinics — a small chain of 3 veterinary clinics. We're drowning in manual work and I've been told AI agents can help us run the company better. I need you to read through all the internal documents in our workspace and produce a formal automation plan in a file called automation_plan.json.

The plan should cover: what VetPaw actually does and where our biggest bottlenecks are, a mapping of each of our key business functions to the right kind of AI approach, the order we should tackle these in (be careful — this is NOT just 'most important first'), and how we should roll things out carefully without breaking anything. 

Also flag any areas where we absolutely should NOT hand full control to AI — our CEO is very clear that certain types of decisions must stay with humans or external professionals.

There's a SKILL.md file in the workspace that describes the methodology you should follow. Please use it.
